text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! ☆ That was a really impressive win, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This plushie feels sooo good. It's all soft and fluffy… Just like a pancake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think I'll make pancakes for my afternoon snack today. ♪ I'm going to make a full stack!
